Sandbox_DansClimateWindowACLoot_tooltip:
How often window air conditioners turn up, in percent of the mod's normal rate. 100 is normal, 200 twice as often.
0: none spawn as loot.
They are found in appliance shops and big-store electronics aisles, sometimes in hardware stores, and rarely in warehouse crates and garages. Places you have already visited keep the loot they rolled.
Sandbox_DansClimateSpaceHeaterLoot_toolt:
How often electric space heaters turn up, in percent of the mod's normal rate. 100 is normal, 200 twice as often.
0: none spawn as loot.
They are found in appliance shops and big-store electronics aisles, sometimes in hardware stores and bedroom closets, and rarely in warehouse crates and garages. Places you have already visited keep the loot they rolled.
Sandbox_DansClimateACNoise_tooltip:
How far away zombies hear a running window air conditioner on High, in tiles. On Low it carries a little over half as far, and a working central air conditioner half as far again.
0: zombies never hear either.
For scale, a running generator is heard from 20 tiles.
Sandbox_DansClimateUnitPowerDraw_tooltip:
How much generator fuel a running window air conditioner, space heater, furnace or central air conditioner uses, in percent of the mod's normal rate.
At 100 an air conditioner costs 0.07 L/h on Low and 0.11 on High, a space heater 0.09 on Low and 0.15 on High, a furnace 0.40 and a central air conditioner 0.35 while they are working (the game charges 0.09 for a stove and 0.13 for a fridge-freezer).
0: they run for free.
Sandbox_DansClimateCentralUnitLoot: Furnace and Central Air Conditioner Loot (%%)
Sandbox_DansClimateCentralUnitLoot_toolt:
How often an electric furnace or a central air conditioner turns up, in percent of the mod's normal rate. 100 is normal, 200 twice as often.
0: none spawn as loot.
They are rare: appliance shops and generator rooms, and now and then a warehouse crate. Places you have already visited keep the loot they rolled.
Sandbox_DansClimateCentralBookLoot_toolt:
How often the two manuals that teach installing a furnace, a central air conditioner and vents turn up, in percent of the mod's normal rate. 100 is normal, 200 twice as often.
0: none spawn as loot, so nobody can install them.
At 100 they are a tenth as common as the last volume of a skill book, or rarer: trade bookshelves, hardware stores, libraries, an engineer's or electrician's things.
Sandbox_DansClimateComfortEnabled_toolti:
Being cold or too warm for what you are wearing wears on your mood and energy, well short of hypothermia or heatstroke: unhappiness and stress creep up in a chill, you tire faster when it is too warm, and you sleep worse in either. Being comfortable indoors while the weather is bad eases unhappiness and stress.
Off: temperature only matters through the game's own hypothermia and overheating.
Sandbox_DansClimateComfortStrength_toolt:
How strongly comfort and discomfort affect mood, tiredness and sleep, in percent of the mod's normal amounts.
At 100, a full chill adds 2 unhappiness an hour (never past 40), full heat makes you tire a quarter faster, a night slept in either is up to 15 percent worse, and being cosy takes 2 unhappiness an hour off.
